subject.statement: Do Kwon is currently in custody in Montenegro.

summary: As of 2026-10-13, the claim that Do Kwon is currently in custody in Montenegro is FALSE. He was arrested in Montenegro on 23 March 2023, extradited to the United States and handed over to the FBI on 31 December 2024, and has been serving a 15‑year federal prison sentence in the US since early 2026, meaning he is not detained or imprisoned in Montenegro at the present date.

findings.statement: Do Kwon's full legal name is Kwon Do Hyeong (also rendered Kwon Do-hyung) and he was born on 6 September 1991.
Do Kwon was arrested on March 23, 2023 at Podgorica airport while attempting to fly to Dubai using a fake passport.
Do Kwon was extradited to the United States and handed over to FBI agents at Podgorica Airport on December 31, 2024.
As of early 2026, Do Kwon is serving a 15-year federal prison sentence in the United States, and therefore is not detained or imprisoned in Montenegro as of 2026-10-13.
